verdict.rationale: Ashby's own comparison page says the platform combines ATS with a Scheduling module, and its webhook docs list interview scheduling events, so scheduling exists in some form. Nothing in the pack describes candidate self-scheduling, booking links, live calendar availability, or timezone handling. missing for 10: documented candidate self-scheduling links, sync with team calendars (Google/Office 365), live availability and timezone handling, independent or hands-on corroboration
